01 / The vision

Good research grows together.

Three priorities I’ll work toward
with you and the committee.

People → possibilities

Find your people.

An opt-in directory of interests and skills to help you find your next research collaborator.

Across interests. Across experience levels.
Ideas → stronger projects

Build with feedback.

Peer feedback sessions and practice talks to develop your idea and present it with confidence.

Bring a question, a draft, or a work in progress.
Research → new opportunities

Get your work seen.

A curated digest of conferences, competitions, and funding calls, with clear deadlines and requirements.

Less searching. More time to prepare.

02 / Research in action

Urban Heat Island
Prediction Mapping.

AI and geospatial research on urban heat in Mombasa. Presented at ISK in 2024 and GHACOF in 2025.
